scripts.purpose: Runs on a server and produces a read-only Arch Linux maintenance report, then clears that server's pending maintenance marker. Settings are hardcoded in the script: it ignores arguments and does not load a config file or contact other hosts. install.sh deploys this script to each host in REMOTE_SERVERS and does not run it remotely. The Git repository check is performed by invoking /usr/local/bin/git-checker.sh, deployed separately from remote/git-checker.sh. Open questions: remote/config is planned for deployment by install.sh but this script does not source any config file, so its hardcoded backup path, snapshot limits, and checker path remain fixed.

environment.description: Base for the maintenance state directory holding pending and last-reminder.
